title: NECLive 2026: Home Advantage
blurb: Nigeria's entertainment and creative economy conference. Student ₦5,000, individual ₦15,000, duo pass ₦25,000.
about: NECLive is Nigeria's conference on the entertainment and creative economy. This year's theme is Home Advantage: what it takes to build creative businesses that win at home first.
Student ₦5,000, individual ₦15,000, duo pass ₦25,000. Doors open at 8 AM at Alliance Française, Mike Adenuga Centre, Ikoyi.

title: DevFest Lagos 2026
blurb: Two days of workshops, talks and networking from the Google developer community. ₦8,000 a day or ₦16,000 for both.
about: DevFest Lagos is the Google Developer Groups community's biggest event of the year: two days of talks, workshops and hands-on sessions on Android, web, cloud, AI and more.
Tickets are ₦8,000 a day or ₦16,000 for both days. The venue is announced to ticket holders.

title: Lagos International Theatre Festival
blurb: Two days of theatre themed "The Masks We Wear".

title: Lagos State Employment Summit 2026
blurb: The fourth Lagos employment summit, "Lagos Works", for job seekers and employers. A career fair runs on 16 Nov.
about: Lagos Works, the fourth Lagos State Employment Summit, brings job seekers, employers and training partners together at the Landmark Event Centre, with a career fair alongside the main sessions.
Entry is free with registration on the Lagos State site.

title: EWA 2026: Opening Night
blurb: Entertainment Week Africa opens its fifth edition, "Closing The Gap", across music, film, fashion and tech.
about: Entertainment Week Africa opens its fifth edition, Closing The Gap, with a free opening night at the Livespot Entertarium in Ikate. The week runs across music, film, fashion and tech.

title: Jokes n Jollof
blurb: Comedy night of Entertainment Week Africa. Early bird ₦25,000, VIP ₦120,000.

title: The Runway Coterie
blurb: The fashion night of Entertainment Week Africa, free general access.

title: Livespot X Festival 2026
blurb: The concert that closes Entertainment Week Africa. Early bird ₦20,000, general ₦50,000, VIP up to ₦200,000.
about: The concert that closes Entertainment Week Africa. Early bird ₦20,000, general ₦50,000, VIP up to ₦200,000.

title: Detty December Fest: Wizkid Opening Night
blurb: Wizkid opens the 13-day, two-stage Detty December Fest, running 18 to 30 December.
about: Detty December Fest runs for 13 days, 18 to 30 December, across two stages. Wizkid opens it.
Tickets are on the official site; buy only from official sellers.

title: Abuja International Afrojazz Festival
blurb: The main concert of a week of African rhythms and jazz, after masterclasses from 16 November. Early bird ₦5,000, VIP ₦15,000.

title: Arewa Festival 2026
blurb: Two days of Northern Nigerian food, fashion, crafts and business with 500+ exhibitors. VIP ₦50,000.

title: Wizkid Live in Abuja
blurb: Wizkid's Abuja homecoming show at Eagle Square.

title: FNB Accra Marathon
blurb: The 35th edition: full marathon, 10K and a free 10K for under-18s, with 8,000+ runners expected.

blurb: Sculptor Frederick Okai's solo show opens, running until April 2027.

blurb: A one-day trade expo with delegates and exhibitors from Africa and Asia.

title: Detty Rave 2026
blurb: Mr Eazi's December party, the night that named the season.

title: AfroFuture 2026
blurb: Three days of music, fashion and art, 28 to 30 December. Buy only from official sellers.

title: Overnight Movie Experience
blurb: The overnight edition of Freeverse's movie night: watch, then review the films together in a cosy studio.
about: Freeverse Studios turns its regular movie night into an overnight session. You watch a run of films back to back, then stay for an open conversation where everyone reviews what they saw.
Entry is by RSVP on the organiser's page. Bring something warm; it runs late.

title: TEMP House Experience 6.0
blurb: The sixth edition of the TEMP house-music night in Ikeja.
about: The sixth edition of TEMP House Experience, a house-music night in Ikeja built around long DJ sets and a dance floor that stays full till morning.
Tickets are ₦50,000 on shows.ng. The exact venue is shared with ticket holders before the night.

title: Frequency Arena
blurb: A day of live music and games on Admiralty Way, Lekki.
about: Frequency Arena takes over 15 Admiralty Way, opposite Farm City in Lekki Phase 1, for a day of live music, games and hanging out.
Doors open at 9 AM. General tickets are ₦5,000 on shows.ng.

title: Nexus by Qore 2026
blurb: Qore's conference on the future of finance and technology in Nigeria, at the Federal Palace Hotel.
about: Nexus is Qore's conference on where finance and technology are heading in Nigeria: banks, fintechs, regulators and builders in one room for a day of talks and panels.
It runs at the Balmoral Convention Centre in the Federal Palace Hotel, Victoria Island, from 9:30 AM. Registration is free on Luma and spaces are limited.
venue: Balmoral Convention Centre, Federal Palace Hotel

title: The Fitness Party of the Year
blurb: The VerveLife 9.0 grand finale: a full day of group workouts, music and wellness at Eko Hotel.
about: The grand finale of VerveLife 9.0. Expect a full morning of group workouts, dance fitness, wellness stalls and music, run by Access Bank's Verve community at Eko Hotel and Suites.
It starts at 7 AM. Wear your gym kit and bring water; registration details are on the VerveLife site.

title: Geo-Innovation Summit 2026
blurb: A summit on geospatial technology, mapping and data for Nigeria. Free entry, with paid delegate passes.
about: A one-day summit on geospatial technology in Nigeria: mapping, satellite data, GIS and how they feed into planning, agriculture and business.
General entry is free. Paid delegate passes, from about ₦30,000, add the full programme and networking.
venue: High Point Event Centre and Suites

title: CONNEXA 2026: The Opportunity Playground
blurb: Talent, founders and recruiters in one room: keynotes, business showcases, career sessions and AI demos. Talent pass ₦5,000, VIP ₦10,000.
about: CONNEXA calls itself the opportunity playground: talent, founders, recruiters and industry leaders in one hall, with keynote conversations, business showcases, exhibitions, AI demos and career sessions.
Talent Pass ₦5,000, Talent VIP ₦10,000, Business Owner Pass ₦30,000. It runs 10 AM to about 5 PM at the UNILAG Indoor Sports Centre.

title: Techfeast 2026
blurb: A full day of tech talks, networking and entertainment on the human side of innovation. The exhibition floor is free from 10 AM to 3 PM.
about: A full day of technology, networking and entertainment focused on the human side of innovation, with the main Techfeast sessions, a Future Skills Week track and an exhibition floor.
The exhibition is free from 10 AM to 3 PM. Full-day passes are on shows.ng.

title: Bae & Boo: Owambe Edition
blurb: A relationship banquet for singles and couples, dressed for an owambe.
about: A relationship banquet for singles and couples with an owambe dress code: music, food, games and conversation hosted by House of Rest International.
It starts at 8:30 PM at The Nest Innovation Technology Park, Yaba. Registration is through the organiser's link.

title: Vibration: Beat 'n' Feet Dance Concert 2026
blurb: Dance, music and fashion on one stage at the UNILAG main auditorium.
about: Beat 'n' Feet's dance concert brings dance crews, live music and fashion to one stage at the J.F. Ade. Ajayi Auditorium on the UNILAG campus.
The show starts at 3 PM. Tickets are on Chasescroll.

title: Gloria! Celebrating The King
blurb: Lagos City Chorale's annual Christmas concert at MUSON.
about: Lagos City Chorale's annual Christmas concert at the MUSON Centre: carols, choral classics and seasonal favourites from one of the city's best-known choirs.
The concert starts at 5 PM. Tickets are on tix.africa and usually go early.

title: Mamafela Festival 2026
blurb: A December village-square rave: music, food and culture in Lekki.
about: Mamafela Festival is a December rave styled like a village square: live music, DJs, food stalls and culture at Justice Mall, Lekki.
Gates open at 4 PM. Tickets are on Trend My Event.

title: Kwagh-hir
blurb: An evening of African folklore: live storytelling, traditional dance, masquerade, crafts and games you join in.
about: Kwagh-hir is an evening of African folklore: live storytelling, traditional dance, masquerade, crafts and games, built so you take part rather than just watch.
It runs from 5 PM to 8:30 PM on GT's Lawn and at the CIIFA SafeHouse, 4 Onikoyi Lane, Ikoyi. Tickets are on Eventbrite.
venue: GT's Lawn and CIIFA SafeHouse, 4 Onikoyi Lane

title: Drunch in the City: Lagos Edition
blurb: African fashion, fine dining, music and networking, from afternoon into the night.
about: Detty Experience brings together African fashion, fine dining, music and networking for a long December afternoon at The Leisure Park Event Center, off Admiralty Way in Lekki.
It starts at 2 PM. Dress the part; tickets are on Eventbrite.
venue: The Leisure Park Event Center, off Admiralty Way

title: Padels & Pilates: Softlife Wellness Morning
blurb: Padel and Pilates sessions, massages and breakfast to recover from December.
about: A softer way to end December: padel and Pilates sessions, massages, breakfast and networking at 23AA Cooper Road, Ikoyi, from Detty Experience.
It runs 9 AM to 1 PM. Bring trainers and a change of clothes; tickets are on Eventbrite.

title: Crossover into 2027

about: The Liberty Church's New Year's Eve service at Landmark Centre Annex: music, worship, testimonies, prophetic declarations and a countdown into 2027.
Doors open at 8 PM. Guest artists are still to be announced; registration is on Eventbrite.

title: Flytime Fest 2026
blurb: Three nights of concerts, 22 to 24 December. Latto, A Boogie Wit da Hoodie and Sexyy Red open the first night.
about: Flytime Fest returns to the Eko Convention Centre for three nights, 22 to 24 December. Latto, A Boogie Wit da Hoodie and Sexyy Red headline the first night, with more names to come.
Tickets are sold by Flytime. Buy only from official sellers.

title: ELITE FEST 2026
blurb: An afternoon-into-night festival headlined by BNXN, with the full lineup still to come.

venue: Balmoral Convention Centre, Federal Palace Hotel
